protocol.low_rank_fit: Column z-score, zero-impute missing values, truncated SVD, R2 by row/column.
protocol.neighbor: Strongest absolute Pearson correlation with >=5 shared cells for evaluations and >=3 for models.
protocol.tests: Two-sided Spearman rank correlation after finite-pair filtering.

pathology_adaptations: Rank-1 expressibility is primary because matched pathology validation selected rank 1; rank-2 is retained for direct BenchPress comparability.
Task family replaces BenchPress's benchmark category metadata.
